claim_ceiling: This package can test scoped internalization and dependence fall in a frozen real-model regime. Assisted repair, predictive selection, internalization, retention, and transfer remain separate claims. No result establishes AGI or general self-improvement.

canonical_authority.current_x6_definition: Distill verified repair trajectories into SFT after removing the intervention's context change, retain the verified target, and require raw unaided gain.
canonical_authority.current_control_gap: The canonical rung names a no-intervention control and SFT on raw failures but does not fully specify a dose-matched ordinary supervised replay control. This protocol proposes that control prospectively and does not represent it as already ratified.
canonical_authority.current_threshold_gap: Current authority requires raw gain and protected-family parent-relative retention but gives no numeric minimum raw gain, lift reduction, transfer gain, independent-world count, or paired-seed count.

historical_reasons: always-negative cell accuracy is 0.9733 while the reported predictor accuracy is 0.9545
the receipt is not an anra-x1-real-1-analysis/v1 receipt
gate_zero_at_freeze.execution_effect: No training, no X6-ready designation, and no scientific X6 or X7 result.
future_unlock_requires: a self-validating anra-x1-real-1-analysis/v1 receipt with decision status SUPPORTED_SCOPED
valid primary prediction and decision gates
the X1 subject manifest matching the X6 parent checkpoint
an eligible qualified checkpoint with exact continuation identity

claim_separation.assisted_repair: An external legal intervention improves evaluator-scored task performance.
claim_separation.predictive_selection: Pre-intervention observations improve intervention choice or utility over frozen baselines; X6 inherits but does not re-establish this claim.
claim_separation.internalization: Verified repair experience improves unaided performance and reduces target-intervention lift against a frozen matched control on fresh worlds.
claim_separation.retention: Each previously qualified protected capability remains at or above its preregistered parent-relative floor after X6.
claim_separation.transfer: Unaided gains hold on separately frozen instance, rendering, causal-structure, and task-family axes.
claim_separation.forbidden_inference: Passing assisted repair, predictive selection, internalization, retention, or transfer alone never establishes AGI.

intervention_contract.registry_source: Bind the accepted X1 intervention registry by exact SHA256; do not copy or weaken legality metadata.
eligible_for_training_experience: verified successful repair of a baseline failure
intervention_contract.oracle_a4_role: Evaluator-only ceiling; never training data or native capability.
intervention_contract.target_intervention: Bound one intervention ID in the run manifest before X6 experience collection.
intervention_contract.cost_model: Use the accepted X1 abstract intervention-unit cost model and bind its exact hash; no currency or wall-clock claim is implied.
intervention_contract.external_support_removal: Training prompt must be derived from the original unaided visible task by the bound support-removal transformation. The assisted prompt may remain only as a hash and provenance artifact.
intervention_contract.answer_revelation_test: The intervention transformation and legality receipt must establish that evaluator truth, gold answers, hidden failure labels, and answer-bearing oracle metadata were unavailable.

forbidden_training_sources: X1 evaluation tasks or sealed outcomes
training_data_contract.supervision_rule: Verified targets from the eligible experience and replay splits may be used. Evaluation labels and evaluator-only metadata may not flow into training records, policy-visible inputs, or checkpoint selection.
training_data_contract.firewall_rule: Reject missing identities, answer-revealing interventions, non-independent verification, retained external support, source-split mismatch, world or causal-structure collision, evaluation data, sealed outcomes, or answer keys.

arms.data: Verified baseline failures repaired by the bound target intervention, transformed to unaided prompts, plus identical replay.
Verified baseline failures not repaired in the experience collection, rendered from the same unaided prompt schema, plus identical replay.
arms.causal_role: Ordinary supervised exposure and replay control for the repair-specific signal.
arms.authority_note: Prospective clarification of the canonical no-intervention/raw-failure control; requires amendment approval.

fair_exposure_contract.paired_parent_state: Byte-identical parent file, parameter state tree, runtime, tokenizer, and source within each seed.
fair_exposure_contract.mismatch_rule: Any dose mismatch invalidates the paired causal claim; report it explicitly and do not pool across incompatible arms.
fair_exposure_contract.data_opportunity_rule: Both trained arms receive equal opportunity to access eligible repair, raw-failure, and replay sources; selection is frozen before training.

split_contract.repeated_interventions_are: paired repeated measures, not independent samples
split_contract.derivative_rule: Every query, rendering, counterfactual, and task derived from one world or causal structure remains in the same split.
split_contract.seed_rule: A new random seed is an instance transfer only after split identity checks; it is never called structural transfer merely because the seed changed.
split_contract.confirmation_freeze: Freeze development, retention, X6 confirmation, and X7 follow-up cohorts before training, with inspection_count 0 and retirement-on-inspection required.
split_contract.retirement_rule: If a confirmation or follow-up cohort is inspected for debugging or tuning, retire it and generate a fresh cohort under a new manifest before confirmation.
split_contract.checkpoint_transfer: Evaluate a distinct qualified checkpoint only when one exists; otherwise report NOT_AVAILABLE rather than substituting the parent.

checkpoint_and_continuation.checkpoint_selection: Use a preregistered fixed final update or select only on X6_DEVELOPMENT metrics. Never use X6_RETENTION, X6_CONFIRMATION, X7_FOLLOWUP, sealed outcomes, or evaluator metadata for selection.
checkpoint_and_continuation.cadence: Bind exact save points before training; a cadence proposal is not a receipt.
checkpoint_and_continuation.resume_validity: A checkpoint without exact state and fresh-process restore evidence is not execution-ready.
checkpoint_and_continuation.architecture_rule: No architecture changes and no silent fallback.

primary_measurements.assisted: Accuracy and valid stopping under every frozen legal intervention, including NO_CHANGE.
primary_measurements.intervention_lift: assisted accuracy minus unaided accuracy for the same task, cluster, arm, and seed
primary_measurements.repair_choice_utility: Report only when a frozen X1 policy receipt is bound; otherwise emit NOT_AVAILABLE.
paired_effects: child unaided minus matched raw-failure/replay control
parent target lift minus child target lift
control target lift minus child target lift
primary_measurements.retention: Report every protected capability separately against the parent-relative floor.
primary_measurements.transfer: Report each frozen axis separately; do not hide a failed axis in an aggregate.
primary_measurements.calibration: Report calibration error and Brier score for unaided and assisted decisions.
primary_measurements.controller: Identify every controller as fixed, learned, human-supplied, externally assisted, or none.

uncertainty.primary_unit: independent latent world or causal-structure cluster

decision_thresholds.sample_size_rationale: The proposal uses at least three paired seeds and 80 independent confirmation worlds, targeting 120, so uncertainty is based on world clusters rather than repeated queries. A simulation-based power analysis using development-only effect and variance estimates must be reviewed before these values become authoritative.
decision_thresholds.prospective_rule: No threshold may be selected or altered after any confirmation outcome is inspected.

necessary: preregistered raw unaided gain over the paired parent
preregistered raw unaided gain over the dose-matched ordinary supervised/replay control
preregistered reduction in target-intervention lift versus parent and control
every protected capability passes the parent-relative retention floor
fresh confirmation worlds and frozen protocol
insufficient: unaided gain without reduced intervention lift
gain matched by ordinary supervised exposure

x7_contract.entry_requires: A valid supported X6 result, a fresh X7_FOLLOWUP cohort, the same frozen parent/control/child identities, and a new outcome-blind commitment.
x7_contract.assistance_removed: No target-intervention context or controller support is present in unaided runs.
x7_contract.reduced_assistance: Measure the same frozen legal intervention set separately; reduced target assistance cannot be inferred from missing evaluator data.
x7_contract.task_scope: The frozen X6 target and transfer task distributions; no new task family may be introduced after X6 outcomes.
measurements: unaided child gain over parent and matched control
parent target lift minus child target lift
control target lift minus child target lift
dependence_fell_requires: unaided gain is retained on X7_FOLLOWUP
target intervention lift falls versus parent and control
unrelated intervention lift remains within the authorized bound
the effect is not explained by ordinary task fine-tuning or training-template memorization
failure_routes_to_x6: memorization or training-template performance is the only positive result
x7_contract.self_improvement_rule: Repeated scripted training generations are not self-improvement. A fixed, learned, human, or externally assisted controller must be named, and external assistance cannot be counted as unaided.

stop_rules: Stop before dataset construction unless the X1 entry audit passes and binds the same parent subject.
Stop before training if any arm, split, source, checkpoint identity, continuation field, or protocol hash is missing or altered.
Stop if intervention legality, support removal, independent verification, or the training firewall fails.
Stop and retire a cohort if confirmation or follow-up data are inspected for debugging or tuning.
Stop checkpoint selection if protected evaluation labels or evaluator-only metadata are requested.
Do not pool arms with exposure, optimizer, schedule, data-opportunity, task, or cluster mismatches.
Do not declare internalization from assisted lift, raw training accuracy, or textual explanation.
Do not run X7 after a negative or inconclusive X6 result.
invalid_run_conditions: evaluation task or sealed outcome in training
external support retained in a repair record
evaluation labels used for checkpoint selection

bounded_compute_estimate.current_assignment: No model inference, training, sealed evaluation, GPU/TPU campaign, or external job is authorized.
bounded_compute_estimate.method: After an eligible checkpoint and generator are bound, measure tokens/second, optimizer-state bytes, checkpoint save/load time, and intervention cells/second on the authorized device. Multiply by the frozen update, world, intervention, seed, and checkpoint counts.
bounded_compute_estimate.runbook_requirement: A future operator must provide device type, memory, precision, expected wall time, storage, interruption budget, and exact resume/transfer custody before launch.

unresolved_before_execution: Accept or reject the prospective ordinary supervised/replay control amendment.
Approve or revise the proposed X6 and X7 numeric decision thresholds before any confirmation outcome exists.
Complete development-only simulation-based power analysis and freeze minimum independent worlds and paired seeds.
Obtain a valid qualified X1-REAL-1 analysis receipt and matching subject manifest.
Supply and qualify the exact parent checkpoint, parameter tree, tokenizer, runtime, source release, and continuation receipt.
Bind intervention registry, target intervention, cost model, and transformations.
Freeze generator identities and all six split manifests before training.
Bind optimizer, schedule, exposure counts, data opportunities, checkpoint cadence, evaluation timing, and controller provenance.
Freeze confirmation and X7 cohorts and seal evaluator/verifier identities.
exact_next_action: The X-factor owner must review and version the proposed control/threshold amendment, then direct an authorized operator to complete the missing eligible-checkpoint and X1-REAL-1 prerequisites; do not train from this blocked package.
